summary: #1680 probe: H3-Image t2i on mps from pre-quantized int8 folders, one component at a time.
description: Stage A of #1680 (#1729). The catalog template (templates/minimax-h3-image/text-to-image) needs both int8 components resident at once (~64 GB warm, host_ram_gb 64), which a 64 GB unified-memory Mac can't hold beside the OS, and on unified memory group offload frees nothing. This bench workflow cuts the H3-Image modular pipeline in two. Step 'encode' loads only the text encoder (with its tokenizer and processor) from the pre-quantized folder /Users/don/diffusers-workspace/bench/assets/h3-prequantized-int8/text_encoder, removes lm_head, truncates the language model to 51 layers (the pipeline reads hidden_states[50]), runs only the before_encode and text_encoder blocks, returns prompt_embeds and text_token_tags, and is released. Step 'generate' loads only the transformer, from /Users/don/diffusers-workspace/bench/assets/h3-prequantized-int8/transformer, and the VAE from MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3-Image (vae_diffusers, ~1 GB, not the int4 h3-prequantized/ VAE), runs only the denoise and decode blocks, and saves one PNG under final. The folders are dw quantized-cache entries saved on lem (sdnq 0.2.8, int8, the template's modules_to_not_convert), so no quantization_config is passed: sdnq reads each folder's own. A local path is never quantized-cache keyed (LOCAL_PATH) and nothing of 64 GiB is downloaded. On mps dw loads without quantized matmul (dequantize on use). Host-specific: the paths exist only on mini-ai, so this stays in bench, never the catalog. The sampler is fixed by the checkpoint (6 steps, guidance distilled). width and height are multiples of 32; a canvas under min_generation_area (default 4194304) is generated at that area and resized back.

variables.prompt: A weathered lighthouse keeper in a wool coat stands on the gallery of a white lighthouse at dusk, a storm rolling in over a grey sea behind him, wind pulling at his coat. Photographic, natural skin texture, 50 mm, eye level.

width.reason: MiniMax-H3-Image's canvas is a multiple of 32 (VAE compression 16 x patch 2); refused here rather than after the weights load
